title: gentiana umbellata var. holosteoides
intro: Gentiana umbellata var. holosteoides, commonly known as  Small or Little Gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is often used to treat various conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana umbellata var. holosteoides include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside, amarogentin, and gentiogenin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
